creativity.description: Controls how loosely the model interprets the prompt. Higher means more creative results that may drift from the prompt; low or raw values stay closer to the prompt.
creativity.title: Creativity

image_style_references.description: Optional list of reference image URLs that guide the style of the generated image. At most 10 entries.

image_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of a reference image.
image_url.title: Image URL

strength.description: How strongly the reference steers the style, from -1 to 1. Around 0.6 is balanced: 0.3-0.5 adds subtle character, 0.8-1 lets the reference dominate, and negative values push away from it.
strength.title: Strength

image_style_references.title: Image Style References

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.x-workbench-default: A Van Gogh-tinged Provençal farmhouse under starry nights.
